mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 36 degrees with overcast skies by the Military Ridge State Trail, and we are under a Full Moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.
City Hall reports no new business or urgent emails for residents to be aware of at this time.
Today you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's or yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, we have trivia at The Bogey Factory and the start of ART House 360 Thursday nights.
There were no noteworthy incidents reported in our weekly police update.
Today's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate Decadence. The restaurant is currently open, so make sure to stop by before they close at 10 PM.
